sections.sourceMarker: Nhắc tới Hàn Quốc ngoài kim chi
sections.thesis: A mature market can still turn leverage into a personal debt crisis.
sections.heroConcept: A KOSPI plunge exposes borrowed buying power and ends at the margin-call threshold.

heroConcepts: KOSPI shock opens and closes the argument
borrowed buying power doubles both directions
housing debt turns a shortcut into necessity
the gaemi crowd moves as one leveraged force
CFD hides the person carrying the risk
speculation reroutes like water around a dam
a young worker needs a safer route to wealth
visualMotifs: a red margin threshold crossing the frame
an ant crowd gathering behind one order
a distant home receding from a young worker
water rerouting around a regulatory barrier
a phone tap turning into a debt contract
forbiddenRepeats: idle host beside an unrelated icon
the same stage in adjacent tableaux
a repeated pose without a sentence-level emotional reason
generic two-column cards standing in for action

scenes.narration:
Nhắc tới Hàn Quốc ngoài kim chi, phim
tình cảm rồi là mấy anh Opa dóc trẻ ngôi
thì có một vấn đề còn khá đau đầu nữa là
càng nhiều người tin rằng là đầu tư
không còn là chuyện tích lũ lâu dài mà
là con đường ngắn nhất để đổi đời
